newsitem.title: GERMANY: MG shares fall sharply on analysts meeting.
newsitem.headline: MG shares fall sharply on analysts meeting.

text.p: Shares in Germany's Metallgesellschaft AG were sharply lower in pre-bourse electronic trade on Tuesday, falling nearly six percent early on before paring losses over the morning.
Dealers said that Metallgesellschaft's meeting with analysts to discuss its 1995/96 results had been unfavourably received, without giving further details.
The diversified industrial and engineering group was the biggest loser in pre-bourse IBIS trade.
By 0837 MG shares had pulled back some lost ground and were down 1.65 marks at 32.70, a fall of 4.80 percent. At one point the share fell as low as 32.25 marks.
The overall IBIS DAX index was up 4.76 points, or 0.16 percent, at 3,069.46 points.

On Monday the group reported a 70 percent increase in pre-tax profits to 292 million marks ($178 million) for the 1995/96 fiscal year, which lifted the share by 1.10 marks to 33.90 marks in bourse trade.
